    Finite semibrick generators of compact torsion classes #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.single_generator_iff_finite_semibrick {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (T : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)) :
    (∃ (M : FGModuleCat R), T = generatedTorsionClass M) ↔ ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), IsSemibrick ↑s ∧ T = torsionClassGeneratedBySet ↑s

    A torsion class is generated by a single module exactly when it is generated by a finite semibrick.
